rounds.q: What % of the world's energy came from fossil fuels in 2025?
rounds.why: Oil alone supplied about a third of all the energy the world used.
rounds.src: Energy Institute, Statistical Review of World Energy 2026
rounds.fun: Fossil fuels made 86% of the world's energy, and oil alone about a third. Big boss oil!

rounds.q: What % of the world's electricity came from solar power in 2025?
rounds.why: Solar's growth covered about three quarters of the rise in power demand.
rounds.fun: Solar made 9%, and its growth covered about three quarters of new demand. Shine on!

rounds.q: What % of the world's people cook with clean fuels like gas or electricity?
rounds.why: In sub-Saharan Africa, only about 21% of people cook with clean fuels.
rounds.src: UN SDG Report 2025 / Tracking SDG7 (2023 data)
rounds.fun: 74% cook clean, but only about 21% in sub-Saharan Africa. Room to cook up change!

rounds.q: What % of new cars sold worldwide in 2025 were electric?
rounds.why: In China, electric cars were nearly 55% of all new car sales.
rounds.fun: 1 in 4 new cars was electric, and nearly 55% in China. Plug in and roll out!

rounds.q: What % of the world's electricity came from nuclear power in 2025?
rounds.why: Hydropower is still the biggest low-carbon source, at 14% of the world's electricity.
rounds.fun: Nuclear made 9%, but hydropower leads low carbon at 14%. Water wins this round!
